suppress.notes: CVE-2017-10355 affects Oracle Java SE/JRockit versions through Java 9, not Xerces. Dependency-Check's Xerces CPE match is a false positive; this project's runtime is Java 21. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-10355

Xerces 2.12.2 is the newest Xerces 2.x release available from Maven Central, with no patched version in that line. Replacing Xerces requires application changes because code references Xerces-specific classes. Defer parser migration to the separate dependency-modernization effort. https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1451960

CVE-2023-36479 was fixed in Jetty 10.0.16. The scanned jetty-servlets version is 10.0.26, so this Dependency-Check match is a false positive. https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories
CVE-2025-1948 affects Jetty 12.0.0 through 12.0.16, not Jetty 10.0.26. This is a false positive. https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories

The 2026-11-25 Dependency-Check report matches these CVEs against Jetty 10.0.26 artifacts. Jetty 10 is end-of-life and 10.0.26 is its final release in Maven Central; no public patched release exists in this major line. Remediation requires a Jetty 11/12 major upgrade, deferred to the separate dependency-modernization effort. Java 21 does not remediate these findings. This suppression records the compatibility decision, not remediation. https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories
